text: dsh-tauri-notify-webhook 将 DSH 桌面会话完成或异常停止的通知转发到 SMTP 邮件或 pushplus。客户端在观察到会话由运行转为停止后查询宿主记录的结束原因，并且只在窗口失去焦点时发起通知投递。设置页可选择通知渠道，配置 SMTP 服务器信息或 pushplus token，并分别控制任务完成和异常停止通知。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook forwards completed or abnormally stopped DSH desktop session notifications to SMTP email or pushplus while the window is unfocused, with a settings section for delivery options.
想让 DSH 桌面会话结束后能发邮件或 pushplus 通知
DSH 窗口没聚焦时，怎么收到任务完成提醒？
希望任务报错或中断时自动给我发消息
想分别开关正常完成和异常停止的通知
Send me a push when a DSH session finishes while I am away from the desktop.
Can I forward completed and failed task notifications through SMTP or pushplus?
dsh-tauri-notify-webhook 的功能「会话结束通知转发」：将任务完成或异常停止的会话通知发送到所选 SMTP 邮件或 pushplus 渠道；客户端观察会话停止后读取结束原因，再请求宿主投递。
dsh-tauri-notify-webhook 的功能「离开时才推送」：仅当窗口状态为 hidden 时发送通知；客户端在投递前检查窗口状态，窗口仍在前台时不发消息。
dsh-tauri-notify-webhook 的功能「通知渠道配置」：在设置页选择关闭、SMTP 或 pushplus，填写邮件服务器与收发信息或 pushplus token，并保存完成与异常通知开关。
dsh-tauri-notify-webhook 的功能「测试投递」：设置面板可通过当前选择的渠道发送测试消息，用来确认已填写的投递设置可用。
dsh-tauri-notify-webhook 使用前须知：选择 pushplus 时会将 token、通知标题和内容发送到 www.pushplus.plus；设置保存在本机 DSH_HOME 下。
任务完成时我不在电脑前，能不能把提醒发到邮箱？
想在 DSH 设置里填 pushplus token 并测试通知是否能送达

[](./LICENSE)
[](https://nodejs.org)

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · dsh-tauri-notify-webhook：**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Forward a DSH desktop task notification to **email (SMTP)** or **pushplus** — when a task
stops abnormally or completes, and only while the window is not in front of you.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · The problem this solves：The desktop shell already shows a toast when a turn ends, and it is easy to miss for a
reason worth stating precisely:

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · The problem this solves：- A toast is a system notification. If the window is in front of you, you were already
  watching the answer stream in — the toast is noise. If you walked away, the toast is
  gone by the time you come back, and nothing remains on screen.
- The interesting endings are not equally interesting. A turn that ran to the end needs no
  attention. A turn that **errored, was aborted, hit the token ceiling or was blocked** does.
- The host keeps only the **latest** `turn/end` per session, so a finished session leaves no
  queue to read later. Once you were away for that moment, the information is simply gone.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · The problem this solves：This plugin moves the notification off the screen and onto a channel that keeps history,
and it fires only for the two endings you would actually act on.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:iuuuuuuuu/dsh-tauri-notify-webhook
```

The same spec works in the GUI plugin panel (**设置 → 插件 → 安装**), which accepts any npm
spec. For a local checkout, install the directory instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:D:/path/to/dsh-tauri-notify-webhook
```

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Install：There is no build step at install time: `dist/` is committed. This is deliberate — the
desktop profile installs plugins as packages, and a package that has to be compiled after
installation would need a toolchain the profile does not have.

**Restart DSH.** This is required, not optional: the harness keeps loaded plugin modules in
its loader cache, and `hmr.root` defaults to `[]`, so a newly installed plugin does not take
effect in a running host.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Use：Open **设置 → 任务推送**, pick a channel, fill in its fields, press **发送测试**, then
**保存**. The test button only becomes available once the form differs from what is saved,
so a successful test always describes exactly the values you are about to store.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Use：| Channel | What it needs |
| --- | --- |
| 邮件 (SMTP) | SMTP host, port, security, from, to; username and password are optional for relays that accept anonymous mail |
| pushplus | A token from [pushplus.plus](https://www.pushplus.plus); pushes go straight to the official `/send` endpoint |
| 关闭 | Nothing is sent. This is the default |

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Two triggers：| Trigger | Fires when |
| --- | --- |
| 任务完成 | The turn ended with reason `completed` |
| 任务异常停止 | The turn ended any other way — `aborted`, `error`, `blocked`, `max-tokens`, `interrupted`, `forked` |

Both are on by default and are switched independently. Sub-agent sessions are skipped: they
are driven by their parent, so they would otherwise produce a burst of pushes for one task.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Only while you are away：A push is sent only when `document.visibilityState === 'hidden'`. The Tauri shell patches
`document.hidden` to the real window focus state, so this is "the window is not in front of
you" rather than "the tab is in the background". While you are watching the session, the
plugin stays silent.
dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · How one push is decided：The client cannot read a turn's ending reason, so the decision takes two round trips:

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · How one push is decided：1. The session list flips a session from `running: true` to `false` — that edge is the only
   thing watched, so a session that was already finished when the plugin loaded is never
   back-filled.
2. After a 250 ms settle window (a turn can flicker its running flag), the client asks
   `GET /turn-end?sessionId=…` for the reason the host recorded.
3. If the session is still stopped and has not stopped again in the meantime, the client
   posts `POST /delivery`. The host re-reads the settings at that moment and sends.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · How one push is decided：Every step re-checks that the plugin is still loaded, so a reload mid-flight cannot deliver
a stale push.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Where your credentials live：Settings are stored on this machine only, at `$DSH_HOME/notify-webhook/settings`
(`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`). The file is written through the shell's atomic-write
helper, so a crash mid-save cannot leave a truncated config. Nothing is uploaded anywhere
except the channel you configure.

The host routes are loopback-only, and every mutating request must also be same-origin;
a browser page on another origin cannot read your settings or make the plugin send mail.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Requirements：* The DSH **desktop (Tauri)** shell — this plugin is a client of the shell's `dsh-tauri`
  and `dsh-tauri-ui` runtime plugins, and of the `settings.section` slot, so it does not
  apply to a browser-only profile.
* Node.js ≥ 22.15.0.
* For email: an SMTP server you can send through. For pushplus: a token.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
pnpm lint        # eslint .
pnpm test        # vitest run

CI runs the same four gates on Node 22 and 24, and then asserts that `dist/` is up to date
(`git diff --exit-code -- dist`) — if you change `src/`, commit the rebuilt `dist/` with it.

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · Development：`compat/` holds local stand-ins for the two modules the shell injects at runtime
(`dsh-tauri`, `dsh-tauri/client`, `dsh-tauri-ui/client`). They exist so that `tsc` and the
unit tests can run outside the desktop app; `tsdown` marks those specifiers external, so
none of this code reaches `dist/`.

[](https://nodejs.org)

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · dsh-tauri-notify-webhook：[English](./README.md) · **简体中文**

把 DSH 桌面的任务通知转发到**邮件（SMTP）**或 **pushplus**：只在任务异常停止或完成时推送，
而且只在你没盯着窗口的时候推。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 它解决的问题：桌面端在回合结束时本来就会弹一个系统通知，而它很容易被错过，原因值得说清楚：

- 系统通知是屏幕上的东西。窗口就在你面前时，答案是你自己看着流出来的，通知纯属打扰；
  人走开了，通知在你回来之前就已经消失，屏幕上不留任何痕迹。
- 各种「结束」的价值并不一样。正常跑完的回合不需要你做什么；**报错、被中断、
  撞上长度上限、被阻塞**的回合才需要。
- 宿主每个会话只保留**最新**一条 `turn/end`，结束的会话不会留下一份可以事后翻看的队列。
  你恰好离开的那一次，信息就真的没有了。

这个插件把通知从屏幕上挪到一个会留历史的地方，并且只为你真正会处理的那两种结束触发。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:iuuuuuuuu/dsh-tauri-notify-webhook
```

同一条 spec 也可以直接填进 GUI 的插件面板（**设置 → 插件 → 安装**），它接受任何 npm spec。
本地开发时改为安装目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:D:/path/to/dsh-tauri-notify-webhook
```

安装时没有构建步骤：`dist/` 已随仓库提交。这是刻意的——桌面 profile 是把插件当包安装的，
一个装完还要现场编译的包，等于要求 profile 自带那套工具链。

**装完必须重启 DSH。** 这不是可选项：宿主把已加载的插件模块留在 loader cache 里，
而 `hmr.root` 默认是 `[]`，所以新装的插件在运行中的宿主里不会生效。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 使用：打开 **设置 → 任务推送**，选好渠道、填好对应字段，点 **发送测试**，再点 **保存**。
测试按钮只在表单与已保存内容不一致时才可点，所以一次成功的测试描述的恰好是你即将存下的那组值。

| 渠道 | 需要什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 邮件（SMTP） | SMTP 服务器、端口、加密方式、发件人、收件人；用户名与密码可留空，供允许匿名投递的中继使用 |
| pushplus | 在 [pushplus.plus](https://www.pushplus.plus) 申请的 token；推送直发官方 `/send` 接口 |
| 关闭 | 什么都不发。这是默认值 |

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 两个触发时机：| 触发时机 | 何时触发 |
| --- | --- |
| 任务完成 | 回合以 `completed` 结束 |
| 任务异常停止 | 其余任何结束方式——`aborted`、`error`、`blocked`、`max-tokens`、`interrupted`、`forked` |

两项都默认开启，且可各自独立关闭。子代理会话会被跳过：它们由父会话驱动，否则一个任务会连炸出一串推送。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 只在你离开时推送：只有 `document.visibilityState === 'hidden'` 时才推送。Tauri 外壳把 `document.hidden`
接成了真实的窗口聚焦状态，所以这里判的是「窗口不在你面前」，而不是「标签页在后台」。
你正盯着会话看的时候，插件保持安静。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 一次推送是怎么决定的：客户端读不到回合的结束原因，所以判定要走两个来回：

1. 会话列表把某个会话从 `running: true` 翻成 `false`——只有这个边沿会被观察，
   所以插件加载前就已经结束的会话永远不会被补推一条。
2. 等 250 ms 落定（回合的 running 标记可能抖动），客户端向 `GET /turn-end?sessionId=…`
   询问宿主记下的原因。
3. 若会话仍处于停止态、且期间没有再停过一次，客户端再 `POST /delivery`。
   宿主在那一刻重新读取设置并发出去。

每一步都会重新确认插件仍然挂着，所以中途热重载不会投递出一条过期的推送。
section: 一次推送是怎么决定的

text:
dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 凭据存在哪里：设置只存在本机，路径是 `$DSH_HOME/notify-webhook/settings`（`DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`）。
写入走外壳的原子写助手，所以保存途中崩溃不会留下半截配置。除了你配置的那个渠道，
不会有任何东西被上传到别处。

宿主路由只接受回环地址，且每个写操作还必须同源；外部来源的网页既读不到你的设置，
也没法让插件替你发信。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 运行要求：* DSH **桌面（Tauri）**外壳——本插件是外壳 `dsh-tauri` / `dsh-tauri-ui` 运行时插件和
  `settings.section` 槽位的客户端，因此在纯浏览器 profile 里不适用。
* Node.js ≥ 22.15.0。
* 邮件需要一台你能用它发信的 SMTP 服务器；pushplus 需要一个 token。

dsh-tauri-notify-webhook README · 开发：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
pnpm lint        # eslint .
pnpm test        # vitest run

CI 在 Node 22 与 24 上跑同样这四道门，然后断言 `dist/` 是最新的
（`git diff --exit-code -- dist`）——改了 `src/` 就要把重新构建的 `dist/` 一起提交。

`compat/` 里是外壳在运行时注入的那两个模块（`dsh-tauri`、`dsh-tauri/client`、
`dsh-tauri-ui/client`）的本地替身。它们的存在只是为了让 `tsc` 与单元测试能在桌面应用之外跑起来；
`tsdown` 会把这些说明符标成 external，所以这份代码不会进入 `dist/`。
